svg.title: Claude's text is getting an invisible watermark to satisfy the EU; the detector is 'soon'
svg.desc: A probability-ranked word list on the left feeds a watermark-nudged selection arrow into a highlighted token in a horizontal generation pipeline; below, tall and short bars encode the invisible statistical signature as a binary bit sequence. A manhattan lattice probed by 3 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 3926304496.
